title: Introduction to Deep Learning and Historical Milestones
description: Biological inspiration, AI winters, modern resurgence, compute power (GPUs), and big data drivers.

title: Artificial Neurons and the Single-Layer Perceptron
description: McCulloch-Pitts, linear threshold units, Rosenblatt perceptron rule, and linear separability.
subtopics: Inputs, weights, bias and net input

title: Sigmoid, Tanh, ReLU, Leaky ReLU and Softmax
description: Nonlinear mappings: vanishing gradient in Sigmoid/Tanh, ReLU advantages, dying ReLU, and Softmax output.

title: Multilayer Perceptrons and Forward Propagation
description: Input, hidden, and output layers; matrix representation; forward pass computation.

title: MSE, Cross-Entropy and Binary Cross-Entropy
description: Quantifying discrepancy between prediction and target: regression losses vs classification losses.
subtopics: Relationship between Maximum Likelihood and loss

title: Batch, Stochastic and Mini-Batch Gradient Descent
description: First-order optimization: Batch GD, Stochastic GD (SGD), and Mini-Batch compromises.

title: The Chain Rule and Error Backpropagation
description: Computing exact analytical gradients through multi-layer computational graphs via chain rule.
subtopics: Layer gradient updates dL/dW and dL/db

title: Momentum, RMSprop, Adam and Learning Rate Schedules
description: Accelerating convergence: momentum, adaptive learning rates (Adagrad, RMSprop, Adam).

title: Gradient Issues and Weight Initialization
description: Numerical stability in deep models: vanishing/exploding gradients, Xavier/Glorot, and He initialization.

title: L1/L2 Regularization, Dropout and Early Stopping
description: Preventing overfitting: weight decay (L2), dropout random neuron deactivation, and early stopping.

title: Batch Normalization and Internal Covariate Shift
description: Normalizing layer inputs per mini-batch: running mean/variance, gamma scale, and beta shift.

title: Convolutional Layers, Kernels, Padding and Stride
description: Spatial feature extractors: 2D convolution, filter kernels, valid vs same padding, and stride steps.

title: Pooling Layers and Classic CNN Architectures
description: Spatial downsampling with Max/Average pooling, LeNet, AlexNet, VGG, and ResNet skip connections.
subtopics: ResNet residual blocks and identity shortcuts

title: Recurrent Neural Networks and Sequence Processing
description: Sequential modeling: recurrent loops, hidden state persistence, Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT).
subtopics: Hidden state update h_t = tanh(W_hh * h_t-1 + W_xh * x_t)

title: Long Short-Term Memory and Gated Recurrent Units
description: Gated architectures: forget gate, input gate, cell state, output gate (LSTM), and reset/update gates (GRU).
subtopics: Constant error carousel in cell state
LSTM forget, input, and output gates

title: Pretrained Models, Feature Extraction and Fine-Tuning
description: Leveraging ImageNet models, freezing base layers, training custom classification heads, and gradual unfreezing.
